member.summary: Gets or sets the font family of the chart subtitle.
member.value: A string representing the font family of the subtitle text. The default font family is determined by the Chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a subtitle font family of Roboto.
member.remarks: The font family accepts typical CSS font family syntax, allowing customization to match the desired text style.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font family for the subtitle text: <SfChart Title="Sales Data" SubTitle="2023 Overview"> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontFamily="italic" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartTitleStyle.Position
member.summary: Defines the position of the chart title and subtitle.
member.value: An enum value representing the position of the title. The default value is 'Top'.

Left Displays the title and subtitle on the left side of the chart.
Bottom Displays the title and subtitle at the bottom of the chart.
Right Displays the title and subtitle on the right side of the chart.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartRow
member.summary: Represents a row within a chart, providing customization options for its appearance and layout.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartRow.BorderColor
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the chart row border as a string.
member.value: A string representing the border color of the chart row. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the border color for the bottom line of the row, which divides the chart area vertically. Accepts values in hex or rgba as valid CSS color strings.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with custom row borders color: <SfChart> <ChartRows> <ChartRow Height="50%" BorderColor="red"/> <ChartRow Height="50%" BorderColor="blue" /> </ChartRows> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" OpposedPosition="true" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartRow.BorderWidth
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the chart row border in pixels.
member.value: The double value representing the border width of the chart row. The default value is 1 pixel.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the border width for the bottom line of the row, which divides the chart area vertically.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with custom row borders width: <SfChart> <ChartRows> <ChartRow Height="50%" BorderColor="red" BorderWidth="2" /> <ChartRow Height="50%" BorderColor="blue" BorderWidth="2" /> </ChartRows> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" OpposedPosition="true"/> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartRow.Height
member.summary: Gets or sets the height of the row as a string, accepting input in the form of '100px' or '100%'.
member.value: A string representing the height of the row. The default value is "100%".
member.remarks: If specified as '100%', the row will render to the full height of its chart.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom row in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartRows> <ChartRow Height="50%" /> <ChartRow Height="50%" /> </ChartRows> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartRows

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxes
member.summary: Represents a collection of axes within a chart, managing their initialization and customization.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis
member.summary: Represents an axis within a chart, providing customization options for the axis's appearance and behavior.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.IsIndexed
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the category axis should be rendered using the data source index values.
member.value: true if the category axis should be rendered based on the data source index values; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If set to true, multiple series will be rendered based on their data source index values. Each series will be aligned based on the index of data points rather than matching the category names.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable indexed category axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis IsIndexed="true" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports1" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports2" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.IsInversed
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis should be rendered in an inversed manner.
member.value: true if the axis should be rendered in an inversed manner; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If set to true, the axis will be rendered with the greatest value on the axis moving closer to the origin, and vice versa.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to reverse the axis labels for both the x and y axes: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis IsInversed="true" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis IsInversed="true" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the unique identifier name of an axis.
member.value: A string representing the unique identifier name of the axis. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: To associate an axis with the series, set this name to the xAxisName/yAxisName properties of the series.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the name of the axis: <SfChart> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis OpposedPosition="true" RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"/> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.OpposedPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to place an axis in the opposite position of its original position.
member.value: true if the axis should render at the opposite position; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: For a horizontal axis, setting to true will position the axis at the top of the chart. For a vertical axis, setting to true will position the axis at the right side of the chart.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to oppose-position the axis labels for both the x and y axes: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis OpposedPosition="true" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis OpposedPosition="true" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Title
member.summary: Gets or sets the title of an axis.
member.value: A string representing the title of the axis. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: The axis title provides a quick information to the user about the data plotted in the axis.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the title to the axis labels for both the x and y axes: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="XAxis" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Title="YAxis" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ValueType
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of data the axis is handling.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the value type of the axis. Options include: - Double: Renders a numeric axis. - DateTime: Renders a date time axis. - Category: Renders a category axis. - Logarithmic: Renders a logarithmic axis. - DateTimeCategory : Renders a date time category axis.
The default value is ValueType.Double.
member.remarks: This property determines the type of data the axis is handling, and it affects the way axis values are interpreted and displayed on the chart. It is essential to set this property correctly based on the nature of the data being plotted.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Visible
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis elements such as axis labels, tick lines, grid lines, and axis title should be visible.
member.value: true if the axis and its associated elements are visible; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Set this property to control the visibility of various axis elements. When set to false, the axis and its associated elements will not be rendered on the chart.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the visibility of the axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Visible="true" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Visible="false" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Coefficient
member.summary: Gets or sets the radius for polar and radar series charts.
member.value: The double value represents the radius for polar and radar series charts. The default value is 100.
member.remarks: Applicable only for Polar and Radar series type charts.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the radius for polar and radar series charts: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Coefficient="60" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Polar" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ColumnIndex
member.summary: Gets or sets the index of the column with which the axis is associated.
member.value: The index of the column associated with the axis. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only when the chart area is divided into multiple plot areas using the . To bind a horizonatal axis to a specific column, set the axis’s ColumnIndex property to that column’s index.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a divided chart area with multiple columns and binding a horizontal axis to a specific column: <SfChart> <ChartColumns> <ChartColumn Width="50%" /> <ChartColumn Width="50%" /> </ChartColumns> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis ColumnIndex="1" Name="XAxis" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" XAxisName="XAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.CrossesAt
member.summary: Gets or sets the value (numeric, datetime, or logarithmic) at which the horizontal axis line intersects with the vertical axis or vice versa.
member.value: The value at which the horizontal axis line intersects with the vertical axis or vice versa. The default value is null.
member.remarks: If the of the horizontal axis is ValueType.Category, the value for the vertical axis is accepted as a numeric value, which will be considered as the index of horizontal axis labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to create a chart with a secondary Y-axis that crosses at zero: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis Minimum="-10" Maximum="10" Interval="1" OpposedPosition="true" RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" CrossesAt="0" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.CrossesInAxis
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the axis with which the axis line is to be crossed.
member.value: The name of the axis with which the axis line is crossed.
member.remarks: Applicable only when is provided with a value.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to create a chart with a secondary Y-axis named "YAxis" that crosses the primary X-axis at zero: <SfChart> <ChartAxes> <ChartAxis Minimum="-10" Maximum="10" Interval="1" OpposedPosition="true" RowIndex="1" Name="YAxis" CrossesAt="0" /> </ChartAxes> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column" /> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y1" YAxisName="YAxis" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Description
member.summary: Gets or sets the description about the axis and its elements for accessibility purposes.
member.value: A string representing the description about the axis and its elements for accessibility. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: Accepts the values in string.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the description for the primary X-axis in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Description="Primary X-Axis" /> <ChartPrimaryYAxis Description="Primary Y-Axis" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.DesiredIntervals
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that indicates the approximate interval count for axis interval calculation.
member.value: The desired interval count for axis interval calculation. The default value is .
member.remarks: Not applicable when of the axis is ValueType.Category.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates how to set the desired number of intervals on the X-axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis DesiredIntervals="1" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EdgeLabelPlacement
member.summary: Gets or sets the placement of labels at the edge of the axis.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specify the edge label placement for the axis. The options include: - None: No action will be performed, and the label will be rendered as it is. - Hide: Hides the edge label if it exceeds the chart area. - Shift: Shifts the edge labels within the chart area.
The default mode is EdgeLabelPlacement.None.
member.remarks: The longer text labels at the axis edges may only be partially visible in the chart. Utilize this property to place the edge labels efficiently for a better user experience.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to hide edge labels on the primary axis in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis EdgeLabelPlacement="EdgeLabelPlacement.Hide" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EnableAutoIntervalOnZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the axis interval should be calculated automatically with respect to the zoomed range.
member.value: true if automatic interval calculation is enabled during zooming; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: This property affects axis intervals only when the chart is zoomed.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the EnableAutoIntervalOnZooming for the axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis EnableAutoIntervalOnZooming="true/> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"/> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartZoomSettings EnableSelectionZooming="true"></ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EnableScrollbarOnZooming
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the scrollbar for zooming is enabled.
member.value: true if the scrollbar for zooming is enabled; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: If set to true, the axis will be rendered with a scrollbar when the chart is zoomed.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the EnableScrollbarOnZooming for the axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis EnableScrollbarOnZooming="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"/> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartZoomSettings EnableSelectionZooming="true"></ChartZoomSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.EnableTrim
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether axis labels should be trimmed when they exceed the .
member.value: true if axis labels should be trimmed; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If set to true, axis labels which exceed the will be trimmed regardless of the applied.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to trim long labels on the axis and restrict them to a maximum width in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" MaximumLabelWidth="20" EnableTrim="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" XName="X" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.IntervalType
member.summary: Gets or sets the interval type for the DateTime-based axis.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the interval type for the DateTime-based axis. The options include: - Auto: Defines the interval of the axis based on data. - Years: Defines the interval of the axis in years. - Months: Defines the interval of the axis in months. - Days: Defines the interval of the axis in days. - Hours: Defines the interval of the axis in hours. - Minutes: Defines the interval of the axis in minutes.
The default value is IntervalType.Auto.
member.remarks: Choosing an appropriate interval type is essential for displaying DateTime data effectively. For instance, using a larger interval such as Years or Months may be more suitable for data spanning extended periods, while shorter intervals like Hours or Minutes are better suited for data requiring more detailed temporal granularity. Adjusting the interval type helps in achieving clarity and precision in your chart’s time representation.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure the axis to display DateTime values and to show labels at monthly intervals in a Syncfusion Blazor chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Interval
member.summary: Gets or sets the interval for the axis.
member.value: The numeric value representing the interval for the axis. The default value is .
member.remarks: The interval can be customized using for DateTime-based axis and for logarithmic-based axis. For example, if the interval is set to 2 and the is set to Years, it considers 2 years to be the interval.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a custom interval of 2 for the axis in a chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Interval="2" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Minimum
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum range of an axis.
member.value: The value representing the minimum range of an axis. The default value is derived from the values of corresponding data source points.
member.remarks: This property specifies the minimum range for the axis. It determines the lower limit of the visible range on the axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a custom minimum value for the axis in a Syncfusion Blazor chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Minimum="-10" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelPlacement
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies the placement of axis labels with respect to the axis tick lines.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the placement for the axis labels. The options include: - BetweenTicks: Renders the label between the ticks. - OnTicks: Renders the label on the ticks.
The default value is LabelPlacement.BetweenTicks.
member.remarks: The placement of axis labels can have a significant impact on the readability and accuracy of the chart. When labels are placed BetweenTicks, they are centered between tick marks, often used to represent categories or ranges accurately. Alternatively, when labels are placed OnTicks, they align directly with the tick marks, which can be beneficial for pinpointing specific values or time points. Choosing the appropriate label placement contributes to better data comprehension and presentation.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to position the axis labels on the tick: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelPlacement="LabelPlacement.OnTicks" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.Maximum
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum range of an axis.
member.value: The value representing the maximum range of an axis. The default value is derived from the values of corresponding data source points.
member.remarks: This property specifies the maximum range for the axis. It determines the upper limit of the visible range on the axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a maximum value for the axis in chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Maximum="20" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ZoomFactor
member.summary: Gets or sets the scaling factor for the axis during zoom operations.
member.value: The scaling factor for the axis, which ranges from 0 to 1. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: When is set to 0.5, the chart is scaled by 200% along this axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the ZoomFactor of the axis to zoom into the chart: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ZoomFactor="0.5" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.ZoomPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the zoomed axis during zoom operations.
member.value: The position of the zoomed axis, which ranges from 0 to 1.
member.remarks: The ZoomPosition property determines the relative position of the zoomed axis during zoom operations. A value of 0 represents the start of the axis, and a value of 1 represents the end of the axis. This property is used in conjunction with the property to control the zoom behavior along the axis.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to configure the ZoomFactor and ZoomPosition for the X-axis: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ZoomFactor="0.5" ZoomPosition="0.6" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelFormat
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that is used to format the numeric, logarithmic, and datetime labels to all globalize formats. Axis also supports custom label format using placeholders such as {value}K, where the value represents the axis label.
member.value: A string representing the format for processing numeric, logarithmic, and datetime labels.
member.remarks: The supports standard and custom formatting strings. For numeric values, formats like "C", "N", "P", etc., can be applied. For datetime values, formats like "d", "D", "t", etc., are supported. The property is not applicable to category axis labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a currency format to the axis labels: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelFormat="c" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelIntersectAction
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies how to arrange axis labels intelligently when they intersect with each other.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the alignment of axis labels when they intersect. The options include: - None: Show all labels, regardless of intersections. - Hide: Hide labels that intersect with each other. - Trim: Trim labels to fit within the available space when they intersect. - Wrap: Wrap labels to multiple lines when they intersect. - MultipleRows: Display labels in multiple rows when they intersect. - Rotate45: Rotate labels by 45 degrees when they intersect. - Rotate90: Rotate labels by 90 degrees when they intersect.
The default LabelIntersectAction is LabelIntersectAction.Trim.
member.remarks: Note: For the vertical axis, the option is the only applicable choice.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a rotate 45 degrees to the axis labels: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelIntersectAction="LabelIntersectAction.Rotate45" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelPadding
member.summary: Gets or sets the padding for axis labels from the axis line in pixels.
member.value: The numeric value representing the label padding from the axis line in pixels. The default value is 5.
member.remarks: Increasing the padding can prevent labels from overlapping with the axis line, ensuring clear visibility. Conversely, reducing the padding can create a more compact layout, useful for fitting charts into limited spaces. It is important to consider the overall design and label size when setting this value to maintain a clean and readable chart display.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of axis labels relative to the axis line.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the position of labels relative to the axis line. The options include: - Inside: Renders the labels inside the axis line. - Outside: Renders the labels outside the axis line.
The default value is AxisPosition.Outside.
member.remarks: Placing labels inside the axis line (Inside) might be beneficial when you have limited space or when you want a minimal chart appearance. Conversely, placing labels outside the axis line (Outside) can enhance visibility and separation from the chart area, particularly in situations where overlapping with data points or elements might occur. It is important to consider the overall chart layout and data presentation needs when setting this property.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to position the axis labels inside the chart area. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelPosition="AxisPosition.Inside" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelRotation
member.summary: Gets or sets the angle at which the axis labels are rotated.
member.value: A double value representing the rotation angle of the axis labels. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: This property specifies the rotation angle applied to axis labels, which can enhance their orientation and improve readability. It accepts numerical values ranging from 0 to 360 degrees. Negative values indicate angles that are calculated in a opposite direction, starting from 360 degrees. Setting this property allows for customizing how the labels are presented along the axis, accommodating various layout needs.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to rotate the axis labels on the axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis LabelRotation="45" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LabelStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of that specifies the text style of axis labels.
member.value: An instance of .
member.remarks: This property can be used to customize the color and font properties such as size, font-family, font-weight and font-style of axis labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the axis label style for the primary X-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisLabelStyle Color="blue" FontFamily="italic" FontWeight="400" FontStyle="Normal" Size="12px" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LineStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of that controls the customization of axis line.
member.value: An instance of .
member.remarks: This property can be used to customize the color, width, and dash array of the axis line.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the axis line style for the primary axis in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisLineStyle Width="2" Color="red" DashArray="5,1" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.LogBase
member.summary: Gets or sets the base value for the logarithmic axis.
member.value: A numeric value representing the base value for the logarithmic axis. The default value is 10.
member.remarks: This property is applicable only when the of the axis is set to . For example, if the logarithmic base is 10 and the is 2, the axis labels will be placed at intervals of 10^2. Adjusting this value is crucial for ensuring appropriate scale representation in logarithmic value type axis.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.MajorGridLines
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of that controls the customization of major grid lines.
member.value: An instance of .
member.remarks: This property can be used to customize the color, width, and dash array of the major grid lines.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a customize for the axis major gridlines. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisMajorGridLines DashArray="5,1" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartAxisMajorGridLines DashArray="5,1" /> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.MajorTickLines
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of that controls the customization of major tick lines.
member.value: An instance of .
member.remarks: This property can be used to customize the color, width, and height of the major tick lines.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a customized for the axis major tick lines. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisMajorTickLines Color="red" /> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartAxisMajorTickLines Color="blue" /> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.MaximumLabelWidth
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum width for an axis label.
member.value: A numeric value representing the maximum allowable width for an axis label, measured in pixels. The default value is 34.
member.remarks: When is set to true, axis labels that exceed the specified will be trimmed to fit within this limit.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to trim long labels on the axis and restrict them to a maximum width in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category" MaximumLabelWidth="20" EnableTrim="true" /> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" XName="X" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.MaximumLabels
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum number of labels per 100 pixels relative to the axis length.
member.value: A numeric value representing the maximum label count. The default value is 3.
member.remarks: Adjusting this value can help optimize the readability and clutter of axis labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a maximum label count to the primary axis in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis MaximumLabels="5" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.MinorGridLines
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of that controls the customization of minor grid lines.
member.value: An instance of .

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.RangePadding
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that specifies the padding for the axis range in terms of interval.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the range padding of the axis. The options include: - None: Padding cannot be applied to the axis. - Normal: Padding is applied to the axis based on the range calculation. - Additional: Interval of the axis is added as padding to the minimum and maximum values of the range. - Round: Axis range is rounded to the nearest possible value divisible by the interval.
The default value is ChartRangePadding.Auto.
member.remarks: This setting ensures clarity and better axis range handling by allowing extra space or precise boundary control as necessary.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxis.TickPosition
member.summary: Gets or sets the placement of ticks on the axis line.
member.value: One of the enumeration that specifies the placement of ticks with respect to the axis line. Options include: - Inside: Renders the ticks inside the axis line. - Outside: Renders the ticks outside the axis line. The default mode is AxisPosition.Outside.
member.remarks: Adjusting the placement of ticks can have an impact on the readability and aesthetics of the chart. Placing ticks inside the axis line (Inside) may result in a cleaner look when space is constrained. In contrast, placing ticks outside (Outside) can improve clarity and separation from the chart content, especially if data points are dense or close to the axis.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the multi-level labels border.
member.value: A string representing the color of the multi-level labels border. The default multi-level label border color is determined by the chart's theme. By default, the theme is set to with a font color of #b5b5b5. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: Use valid hex or rgba CSS color strings for the color value.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a colored border to a multi-level label on the X-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel> <ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder Color="blue" /> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the border type for multi-level labels.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the border type for multi-level labels. The options include: - Rectangle - Renders the border in a rectangular shape around the label. - WithoutTopBorder - Renders the border without the top edge around the label. - WithoutTopandBottomBorder - Renders the border without both top and bottom edges around the label. - WithoutBorder - Renders the label without any border. - Brace - Renders the border with a brace-like shape around the label. - CurlyBrace - Renders the border with a curly brace-like shape around the label.
The default value is BorderType.Rectangle.
member.remarks: This property determines the style of the border around multi-level labels.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to apply a curly brace border to a multi-level label on the X-axis <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel> <ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder Type="BorderType.CurlyBrace" /> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the multi-level labels border in pixels.
member.value: The width of the border in pixels. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: This property specifies the thickness of the border.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the border width for a multi-level label on the X-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel> <ChartAxisMultiLevelLabelBorder Width="3" /> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartCategory.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the border type for the individual multi-level label.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the border type for the individual multi-level label. The options include: - Rectangle - Renders the border in a rectangular shape around the label. - WithoutTopBorder - Renders the border without the top edge around the label. - WithoutTopandBottomBorder - Renders the border without both top and bottom edges around the label. - WithoutBorder - Renders the label without any border. - Brace - Renders the border with a brace-like shape around the label. - CurlyBrace - Renders the border with a curly brace-like shape around the label.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartMultiLevelLabel.Alignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment of the multi-level labels in the chart.
member.value: One of the enumeration values that specifies the positioning of the multi-level labels. The options include: - Near: Aligns labels at the start of the multi-level label rectangle (left for horizontal orientation, top for vertical orientation). - Center: Centers the multi-level labels within the rectangle. - Far: Aligns labels at the end of the multi-level label rectangle (right for horizontal orientation, bottom for vertical orientation). The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: This property determines how the multi-level labels are positioned relative to their placeholder rectangle, providing flexibility in label presentation. Proper alignment can enhance the readability and visual appeal of chart data.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to alignment the multi-level axis label text in chart. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartMultiLevelLabels> <ChartMultiLevelLabel Alignment="Alignment.Far"> <ChartCategories> <ChartCategory Start="10" End="40" Text="Half yearly 1" /> </ChartCategories> </ChartMultiLevelLabel> </ChartMultiLevelLabels> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartMultiLevelLabel.Overflow
member.summary: Gets or sets the text overflow behavior for multi-level labels.
member.value:
One of the enumeration values specifying text overflow options. Options include: - TextOverflow.Trim: Trims text exceeding defined margins. - TextOverflow.Wrap: Wraps text exceeding defined margins. - TextOverflow.None: Displays text without modification.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartCommonScrollbarSettings.Position
member.summary:
Gets or sets the position of the scrollbar in the chart.
Available options include:
Top: Positions the scrollbar at the top of the chart. Applicable only to horizontal scrollbars.
Bottom: Positions the scrollbar at the bottom of the chart. Applicable only to horizontal scrollbars.
Left: Positions the scrollbar on the left side of the chart. Applicable only to vertical scrollbars.
Right: Positions the scrollbar on the right side of the chart. Applicable only to vertical scrollbars.
PlaceNextToAxisLine: Positions the scrollbar next to the axis line.
member.value: The default value is PlaceNextToAxisLine.

example.code: <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartAxisScrollbarSettings Enable="true" Position="ScrollbarPosition.Bottom"> </ChartAxisScrollbarSettings> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> </SfChart>

member.remarks: Use this property to change the position of the scrollbar in the chart to suit your desired layout.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Size
member.summary: Gets or sets the size of the strip line based on the value and the axis value type.
member.value: The size of the strip line. This property determines the extent or length of the strip line on the chart. The default value is 0.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.SizeType
member.summary: Gets or sets the size type of the strip line.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the unit of strip line size. The options include: - Auto - Automatically determines the appropriate unit based on the data. - Pixel - Measures the size in pixels. - Years - Measures the size in years for date-time axis. - Months - Measures the size in months for date-time axis. - Days - Measures the size in days for date-time axis. - Hours - Measures the size in hours for date-time axis. - Minutes - Measures the size in minutes for date-time axis. - Seconds - Measures the size in seconds for date-time axis.
The default value is SizeType.Auto.
member.remarks: This property allows for flexible sizing of strip lines in both time-based and pixel-based units.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a chart with a primary X-axis that includes a stripline with a specified size type. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis IntervalType="IntervalType.Minutes" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime"> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 00, 00)" End="new DateTime(2016, 06, 13, 08, 05, 00)" Color="#E0E0E0" IsSegmented="true" SegmentStart="1.8" SegmentAxisName="PrimaryYAxis" SegmentEnd="2.2" StartFromAxis="false" SizeType="SizeType.Minutes" /> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StepLineData" XName="X" YName="Y" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Start
member.summary: Gets or sets the start value of the strip line.
member.value: An object representing the start value of the strip line. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property determines where the strip line begins along the axis. Based on the axis type, the value will be assigned.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set a start value for a stripline on the primary Y-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" /> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.StartFromAxis
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the strip line should be rendered from the axis origin.
member.value: true if the strip line should be rendered from the axis origin; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: This property allows you to control whether the strip line starts from the axis origin or from a specified value. If set to true, the stripline will be rendered from the axis origin, ignoring the value if provided.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a stripline on the Y-axis starting directly from the axis line. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="18" End="25" StartFromAxis="true"> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.Text
member.summary: Gets or sets the text for the strip line.
member.value: A string representing the strip line text. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: This property is used to assign a label or descriptive text to the strip line, which can enhance the interpretability of charts by providing contextual information directly on the visual elements. If the text is not set, the strip line will appear without a label, maintaining a cleaner visual appearance but potentially lacking descriptive context.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to display a stripline with a text label on the Y-axis. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="18" End="25" Text="Strip-line"> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.TextStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of which defines the stripline text style.
member.value: The default value is an instance of .

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the text style of a stripline label. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="18" End="25" Text="Strip-Line"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle Size="16px"></ChartStriplineTextStyle> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartStripline.ZIndex

One of the enumerations that specify the order of the strip line. The options include: - Behind: Places the strip line behind the series elements. - Over: Places the strip line over the series elements.
The default value is ZIndex.Behind.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the connector line style.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the connector line.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the type of the connector line. The options include: - Line: Renders the connector line as a straight line. - Curve: Renders the connector line as a curved line.
The default type is ConnectorType.Line.
member.remarks: This property defines how the connector appears in the chart, allowing customization to either a straight or curved style for better visual representation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the connector line.
member.value: A string representing the color of the connector line. The default value is "black".
member.remarks: Accepts values in hex or rgba as a valid CSS color string. It allows customization of the connector line to match the chart's theme or styling preferences.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the connector line.
member.value: A double value representing the width of the connector line. The default value is 1.
member.remarks: Adjust this property to change the thickness of the connector line for better visibility or styling.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.Length
member.summary: Gets or sets the length of the connector line.
member.value: A string representing the length of the connector line. The default value is null.
member.remarks: The length can be specified as a string that defines how far the connector extends, allowing dynamic adjustments based on layout requirements.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultConnector.DashArray
member.summary: Gets or sets the dashArray for the connector line.
member.value: A string representing the dashArray for the connector line. The default value is null.
member.remarks: The property allows customization of the connector line by specifying a dash pattern. This string value defines the pattern of dashes and gaps in the line. For example, "4,2" represents a dash of length 4 followed by a gap of length 2.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation
member.summary: Provides options for animation in the chart component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation.Delay
member.summary: Gets or sets the delay for the animation of the series.
member.value: A representing the delay in milliseconds before the animation starts. The default value is 0.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify how long the chart should wait before beginning the animation. This can help in synchronizing complex animations or staggering them for visual effects.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation.Duration
member.summary: Gets or sets the duration of the animation in milliseconds.
member.value: A representing the total time span of the animation in milliseconds. The default value is 1000.
member.remarks: Adjusting this property allows you to speed up or slow down the animation, making it more visually appealing based on the specific chart's context.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultAnimation.Enable
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the series is animated on initial loading.
member.value: true if the series animation is enabled on initial load; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: Setting this property to true makes the series elements animate when the chart first loads, enhancing the visual engagement of the chart presentation. Disable it for static displays.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultBorder
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the color and width of the border.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultBorder.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color of the border, accepting values in hexadecimal or RGBA formats as valid CSS color strings.
member.value: A string that specifies the color of the chart border. The value must be a valid CSS color string, formatted as either a hexadecimal or RGBA value.
member.remarks: Changing this property will update the visual boundary of the chart's border to match the specified color, enhancing the stylistic appearance or aligning with specific design standards.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set all the borders used in the chart control. <SfChart> <ChartBorder Color="blue" Width="1"></ChartBorder> <ChartArea> <ChartAreaBorder Width="2" Color="green"></ChartAreaBorder> </ChartArea> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"></ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#4b107e" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> <ChartStripline Start="32" End="35" Color="blue"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#d41986" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairLine Width="2" Color="green"></ChartCrosshairLine> </ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartEmptyPointSettings Mode="EmptyPointMode.Average"> <ChartEmptyPointBorder Width="1" Color="brown"></ChartEmptyPointBorder> </ChartEmptyPointSettings> <ChartSeriesBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartSeriesBorder> <ChartMarker Visible="true"> <ChartMarkerBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartMarkerBorder> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendBorder Color="red" Width="2" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultBorder.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the border in pixels.
member.value: A specifying the border's width. The default value is 1, representing 1 pixel.
member.remarks: Adjust this property to increase or decrease the thickness of the chart border, which can help draw focus or emphasize the chart's outline.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set all the borders used in the chart control. <SfChart> <ChartBorder Color="blue" Width="1"></ChartBorder> <ChartArea> <ChartAreaBorder Width="2" Color="green"></ChartAreaBorder> </ChartArea> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"></ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#4b107e" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> <ChartStripline Start="32" End="35" Color="blue"> <ChartStriplineBorder Color="#d41986" Width="2"></ChartStriplineBorder> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairLine Width="2" Color="green"></ChartCrosshairLine> </ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartEmptyPointSettings Mode="EmptyPointMode.Average"> <ChartEmptyPointBorder Width="1" Color="brown"></ChartEmptyPointBorder> </ChartEmptyPointSettings> <ChartSeriesBorder Width="1" Color="black"></ChartSeriesBorder> <ChartMarker Visible="true"> <ChartMarkerBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartMarkerBorder> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelBorder Width="2" Color="red"></ChartDataLabelBorder> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendBorder Color="red" Width="2" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the text style of the chart component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.Color
member.summary: Gets or sets the color for the text.
member.value: A string representing the color for the text. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Accepts values in hex and rgba as a valid CSS color string.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font color for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle Color="black"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyleColor="blue"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle Color="red"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle Color="green"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle Color="red"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle Color="red"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle Color="green"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont Color="yellow"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle Color="blue"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.FontFamily
member.summary: Gets or sets the font family for the text.
member.value: A string representing the font family for the text. The default value is "Segoe UI".
member.remarks: This property specifies the font face used in rendering the text, offering a wide variety of standard and custom fonts.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font family for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle FontFamily="Arial" /> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont FontFamily="Arial"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontFamily="Arial"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.FontStyle
member.summary: Gets or sets the font style for the text.
member.value: A string representing the font style for the text. The default value is "Normal".

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font style for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle FontStyle="bold"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont FontStyle="bold"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontStyle="bold"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.FontWeight
member.summary: Gets or sets the font weight for the text.
member.value: A string representing the font weight for the text. The default value is "Normal".
member.remarks: Use this property to define the thickness of the text characters, providing levels of boldness.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a custom font weight for the text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle FontWeight="600" /> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont FontWeight="600"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontWeight="600"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.Opacity

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.TextAlignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the text alignment.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the alignment of the text. The options include:
Near - Aligns the text to the start of the container.
Far - Aligns the text to the far end of the container.
Center - Aligns the text to the center of the container.
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: Text alignment adjusts the horizontal placement of text within its container, affecting its position relative to other content.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a text alignment for the subtitle text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle TextAlignment="Alignment.Far"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultFont.TextOverflow
member.summary: Gets or sets the text overflow behavior to employ when the text exceeds the defined margins.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the text overflow options. The options include: - TextOverflow.Trim: Trims the text if it exceeds the defined margins. - TextOverflow.Wrap: Wraps the text if it exceeds the defined margins. - TextOverflow.None: Shows the text as it is.
The default value is TextOverflow.Trim.
member.remarks: This property manages how text should behave when it's too long for its allocated space, either by trimming, wrapping, or displaying fully.

example.code: // The following code demonstrates setting a text alignment for the subtitle text. <SfChart Title="Olympic Medals" SubTitle="In the year 2023"> <ChartTitleStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartTitleStyle> <ChartSubTitleStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartSubTitleStyle> <ChartPrimaryXAxis Title="Country" ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.Category"> <ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip Enable="true"> <ChartCrosshairTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartCrosshairTextStyle> </ChartAxisCrosshairTooltip> <ChartAxisLabelStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartAxisLabelStyle> <ChartAxisTitleStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartAxisTitleStyle> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartStriplines> <ChartStripline Start="20" End="25" Color="red"> <ChartStriplineTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"/> </ChartStripline> </ChartStriplines> </ChartPrimaryYAxis> <ChartCrosshairSettings Enable="true"></ChartCrosshairSettings> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"> <ChartTooltipTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartTooltipTextStyle> </ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true"> <ChartDataLabelFont TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartDataLabelFont> </ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle TextOverflow="TextOverflow.None"></ChartLegendTextStyle> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultLocation
member.summary: Provides options for customizing the location of chart elements.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultLocation.X
member.summary: Gets or sets the x-coordinate of the legend in pixels.
member.value: A representing the horizontal position of the legend. The value is measured in pixels.
member.remarks: Adjusting this property changes the x-position of the chart legend, allowing it to be precisely aligned within the chart area.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultLocation.Y
member.summary: Gets or sets the y-coordinate of the legend in pixels.
member.value: A representing the vertical position of the legend. The value is measured in pixels.
member.remarks: Changing this property affects the y-position of the chart legend, enabling precise vertical placement within the chart layout.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin
member.summary: Provides the options for customizing the bottom, left, right, and top margins of the chart component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Bottom
member.summary: Gets or sets the bottom margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added below the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: Adjusting the bottom margin allows for additional space at the bottom of the chart, which is useful for accommodating labels or other elements that extend beyond the chart area.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Left
member.summary: Gets or sets the left margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added to the left of the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: The left margin is primarily used to create buffer space on the left side, ideal for accommodating additional labels or annotations.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Right
member.summary: Gets or sets the right margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added to the right of the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: Adjusting the right margin is often necessary to provide extra space for labels or other chart features that extend beyond the chart's immediate area.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultMargin.Top
member.summary: Gets or sets the top margin for the chart component.
member.value: A representing the space in pixels added above the chart component. The default value is double.NaN.
member.remarks: The top margin is useful for creating space at the top of the chart to accommodate titles or legends that might otherwise overlap with chart data.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultSelectedData

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultSelectedData.Series
member.summary: Gets or sets the series index for the selected data.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDefaultSelectedData.Point

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator
member.summary: Defines the technical indicator that is used in financial markets.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of the technical indicator.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the type of technical indicators. The options include: - Sma: Predicts the trend using a simple moving average approach. - Ema: Predicts the trend using an exponential moving average approach. - Tma: Predicts the trend using a triangle moving average approach. - Momentum: Predicts the trend using a momentum approach. - Atr: Predicts the trend using an average true range approach. - AccumulationDistribution: Predicts the trend using an accumulation distribution approach. - BollingerBands: Predicts the trend using a Bollinger approach. - Macd: Predicts the trend using moving average convergence divergence approach. - Stochastic: Predicts the trend using a stochastic approach. - Rsi: Predicts the trend using RSI approach.
The default value is TechnicalIndicators.Sma.
member.remarks: The property determines the algorithm used for trend prediction in the indicator.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to render a candlestick chart with an Accumulation/Distribution indicator. <SfChart> <ChartPrimaryXAxis ValueType="Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ValueType.DateTime" IntervalType="IntervalType.Months"> </ChartPrimaryXAxis> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@StockDetails" Name="Apple Inc" XName="X" Low="Low" High="High" Close="Close" Volume="Volume" Open="Open" Width="2" Type="ChartSeriesType.Candle"> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartIndicators> <ChartIndicator Type="TechnicalIndicators.AccumulationDistribution" SeriesName="Apple Inc" /> </ChartIndicators> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartIndicator.Field
member.summary: Gets or sets the field to compare the current value with previous values.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the financial data fields to compare the current value with previous values. The options include: - High: Defines the highest price in the stocks over time. - Low: Defines the lowest price in the stocks over time. - Open: Defines the opening price in the stocks over time. - Close: Defines the closing price in the stocks over time.
The default value is FinancialDataFields.Close.
member.remarks: This property is used to determine which aspect of financial data (e.g., high price, low price) the indicator should analyze against historical data.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to customize the legend text font family in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true"> <ChartLegendTextStyle FontFamily="Roboto" /> </ChartLegendSettings> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendSettings.Position
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the legend in the chart.
member.value:
One of the enumeration that specifies the position of the legend. The options include: - Auto: Places the legend based on based on width and height - Top : Displays the legend at the top of the chart. - Left : Displays the legend at the left of the chart. - Bottom: Displays the legend at the bottom of the chart. - Right: Displays the legend at the right of the chart. - Custom: Displays the legend based on the given x and y location values.
The default mode is LegendPosition.Auto.
member.remarks: Use this property to position the legend at the top, left, bottom, or right of the Accumulation Chart.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the legend position in a chart. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@MedalDetails" Name="Gold" XName="Country" YName="Gold" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartLegendSettings Visible="true" Position="LegendPosition.Top" /> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartLegendSettings.Alignment
member.summary: Gets or sets the alignment of the legend.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that specifies the legend alignment. Options include: - Near: Aligns the legend to the left or top based on the . - Center: Aligns the legend to the center of the chart. - Far: Aligns the legend to the right or bottom based on the .
The default value is Alignment.Center.
member.remarks: The alignment of the legend works as follows: - Near: Aligns the legend to the top-left of the chart if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right-top of the chart if is LegendPosition.Right. - Center: Aligns the legend to the top center of the chart if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right center of the chart if is LegendPosition.Right. - Far: Aligns the legend to the top-right of the chart if is LegendPosition.Top and to the right-bottom of the chart if is LegendPosition.Right.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the accessibility description for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" AccessibilityDescription="This is a sample series" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.AccessibilityDescriptionFormat
member.summary:
Gets or sets the format string used for the accessibility description of the data points in the . The format string can include the following placeholders:
${series.name}: Displays the name of the series.
${point.x}: Displays the x-value of the point.
${point.y}: Displays the y-value of the point.
${point.high}: Displays the high value of the point. This is applicable only for financial and range series.
${point.low}: Displays the low value of the point. This is applicable only for financial and range series.
${point.open}: Displays the open value of the point. This is applicable only for financial series.
${point.close}: Displays the close value of the point. This is applicable only for financial series.
member.value: A string that specifies the format for the accessibility description of points in the series.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify the format for the points accessibility description of the . The property provides accessibility information for the series root element. However, this property allows you to provide dynamic information based on the data. For example, the format "${series.name} : ${point.x}" displays the series name and x-value of the point in the accessibility description.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to set the accessibility description format for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" AccessibilityDescriptionFormat="${series.name} : ${point.x}" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.EnableTooltip
member.summary: If set to true, the tooltip for the series will be visible.
member.value: A boolean indicating whether tooltips are enabled for the series. The default is true.
member.remarks: Use this property to display additional information about series points when hovering over them with cursor. Note: This property is applicable only when the ChartTooltipSettings.Enable property is set to true.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to disable the tooltip for a chart series. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"></ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" EnableTooltip="false" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartSeries.ShowNearestTooltip
member.summary: Gets or sets a value that determines whether tooltips are displayed for the nearest data point to the cursor for a specific chart series.
member.value: true to display the tooltip for the nearest data point to the cursor on the specific chart series; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: This property controls the display of the tooltip based on the proximity of the nearest data point to the cursor for a specific chart series. The ChartTooltipSettings.ShowNearestTooltip property must be set to true for this property to function. When the ChartSeries.ShowNearestTooltip property is set to false, the tooltip for the nearest data point will not be displayed for the current series, but it may still be shown for other series.

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable and show the nearest tooltip on both the chart and series. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true" ShowNearestTooltip="true"></ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" ShowNearestTooltip="true" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

example.code: // This example demonstrates how to enable tooltip with custom format. <SfChart> <ChartTooltipSettings Enable="true"></ChartTooltipSettings> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@Data" XName="XValue" YName="YValue" TooltipFormat="${point.x}" /> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Format

You can use standard string format specifiers like 'C' for currency, 'P' for percentage, 'N1' for numeric format with one decimal place, etc. Additionally, you can use placeholders like '{value}' in the format string to dynamically represent the data label value.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates how to format the data label using currency format: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Format="{value}°C"/> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Charts.ChartDataLabel.Position
member.summary: Gets or sets the position of the data labels.
member.value:
One of the enumerations that determines the placement of the data label relative to the data points. Position options include: - Outer: Positions the label outside the data point. - Top: Positions the label on top of the data point. - Bottom: Positions the label at the bottom of the data point. - Middle: Positions the label in the middle of the data point. - Auto: Automatically positions the label based on the series settings.
The default value is LabelPosition.Auto.
member.remarks: The position of the data labels determines where they are displayed relative to the data points in the Chart series.

example.code: // The following example demonstrates setting the position of data labels: <SfChart> <ChartSeriesCollection> <ChartSeries DataSource="@WeatherReports" XName="X" YName="Y" Type="ChartSeriesType.Column"> <ChartMarker> <ChartDataLabel Visible="true" Position="LabelPosition.Outer"></ChartDataLabel> </ChartMarker> </ChartSeries> </ChartSeriesCollection> </SfChart>
