member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent
member.summary: Represents a comprehensive diagramming component that provides functionality for creating, editing, and rendering interactive diagrams with nodes, connectors, and various diagramming features.

remarks.para: The serves as the main container for all diagramming operations, including node management, connector routing, layout algorithms, and user interactions.
It handles rendering, event management, serialization, and provides extensive customization options for appearance and behavior.
Key features include drag-and-drop operations, automatic layout algorithms, undo/redo functionality, clipboard operations, and export capabilities to various formats.

member.summary: Renders the diagram. It contains all the properties of the diagram to be rendered.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.HistoryManager
member.summary: Gets or sets the history manager for the that handles undo and redo operations.
member.value: A that manages the history of changes made to the diagram. The default value is a new instance of .

remarks.para: The history manager tracks all changes made to the diagram and provides functionality to undo and redo operations.
It maintains a stack of history entries that can be navigated through programmatically or via user interactions.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.Tooltip
member.summary: Gets or sets the tooltip that should be shown when the mouse hovers over nodes or connectors in the .
member.value: A representing the tooltip configuration for the diagram. The default value is .

remarks.para: The diagram tooltip is displayed when nodes and connectors have their constraint values set to "InheritTooltip".
Individual nodes and connectors can override this diagram-level tooltip by setting their own properties.
The tooltip appears on mouse hover and provides contextual information about diagram elements.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.BridgeDirection
member.summary: Gets or sets the direction of the bridge that is inserted when connector segments intersect in the .
member.value: A enumeration value specifying the direction of the bridge when connector segments intersect. The default value is .

remarks.para: Bridge direction determines the visual appearance of connector intersections by controlling which direction the bridge arc faces.

item.description: - Creates bridges that arc toward the left side of the intersection
- Creates bridges that arc toward the right side of the intersection
- Creates bridges that arc toward the top of the intersection
- Creates bridges that arc toward the bottom of the intersection

member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to set the bridge direction for connector intersections.
<SfDiagramComponent Height="900px" Width="1200px" BridgeDirection="Direction.Right" Connectors="@connectors"> </SfDiagramComponent>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.ID
member.summary: Gets or sets the unique identifier of the .
member.value: A representing the unique identifier for the diagram component. The default value is a randomly generated string.

remarks.para: The ID property serves as a unique identifier for the diagram component instance, enabling programmatic access and reference to the specific diagram.
This identifier is automatically generated if not explicitly provided.

member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to set a custom ID for the diagram component.
<SfDiagramComponent Height="900px" Width="1200px" ID="myCustomDiagram"> </SfDiagramComponent>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.BridgeDirectionChanged
member.summary: Gets or sets the callback that is invoked when the bridge direction of the changes.
member.value: An that is triggered when the bridge direction is modified. The default value is an empty event callback.

remarks.para: Use this callback to respond to changes in the connector bridge direction and apply related UI updates or business logic.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.DataSourceSettings
member.summary: Gets or sets the data source configuration for binding external data to the .
member.value: A object that configures the data binding properties for the diagram. The default value is .

remarks.para: The enables automatic generation of diagram nodes and connectors from data sources. This is particularly useful for creating automatic layouts.
When configured, the diagram will automatically create nodes based on the data source items and establish parent-child relationships using the specified ID and ParentID properties.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.Model
member.summary: Gets or sets the diagram model used to generate and render the diagram.
member.value: A instance that defines the structure and content of the diagram. Currently supports for UML sequence diagram generation. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Currently, only UML sequence diagram generation is supported using this model.

example.code:
<SfDiagramComponent Height="600px" Model="@umlModel">
            </SfDiagramComponent>
            @code
            {
                DiagramModel umlModel;
                protected override void OnInitialized()
                {
                umlModel = new UmlSequenceDiagramModel()
                {
                    Participants = new List<UmlSequenceParticipant>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "User",
                            Content= "User",
                            ShowDestructionMarker= true,
                            IsActor= true,
                            ActivationBoxes= new List<UmlSequenceActivationBox>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceActivationBox() { ID = "act1", StartMessageID= "MSG1", EndMessageID= "MSG3" }
                            }
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "Server",
                            Content= "Server",
                            ShowDestructionMarker= true,
                            IsActor= false,
                            ActivationBoxes= new List<UmlSequenceActivationBox>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceActivationBox() { ID = "act2", StartMessageID= "MSG1", EndMessageID= "MSG3" }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    Messages = new List<UmlSequenceMessage>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceMessage()
                        {
                            ID = "MSG1",
                            Content = "User sends request",
                            FromParticipantID = "User",
                            ToParticipantID = "Server"
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceMessage()
                        {
                            ID = "MSG2",
                            Content = "Processing",
                            FromParticipantID = "Server",
                            ToParticipantID = "Server"
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceMessage()
                        {
                            ID = "MSG3",
                            Content = "Server sends response",
                            FromParticipantID = "Server",
                            ToParticipantID = "User"
                        }
                    },
                    Fragments = new List<UmlSequenceFragment>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceFragment()
                        {
                            ID = "frag1",
                            Type = UmlSequenceFragmentType.Optional,
                            Conditions = new List<UmlSequenceFragmentCondition>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceFragmentCondition()
                                {
                                    Content = "Interactions",
                                    MessageIds = new List<string>(){"MSG1", "MSG2", "MSG3"}
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    };
                }
            }

member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable support for chunk messages in the .
member.value: A indicating whether chunk message support is enabled. The default value is .

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.SnapSettings
member.summary: Gets or sets the snap settings that define grid lines and specify how and when objects must be snapped in the .
member.value: A object that represents the grid lines and snapping behavior configuration for the diagram. The default value is .

remarks.para: The snap settings control the visual grid display and automatic snapping behavior of diagram elements. When configured, objects will automatically align to grid intersections or specified angles during drag operations.
Use the property to control snapping behavior and grid line visibility. The property defines the angular increment for rotation snapping.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SfDiagramComponent.ShowTooltipAsync(Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.IDiagramObject)
member.summary: Shows the tooltip for the specified diagram object when the tooltip is configured with custom open mode.
member.param: An representing the diagram element (node or connector) for which the tooltip should be displayed. The object must have a tooltip configured with set to "Custom".
member.returns: A representing the asynchronous operation of displaying the tooltip.

example.code:
<SfDiagramComponent @ref="diagram" Width="1000px" Height="500px" @bind-Nodes="@nodes"></SfDiagramComponent>  
            @code{  
            SfDiagramComponent diagram;  
            DiagramObjectCollection<Node> nodes = new DiagramObjectCollection<Node>();  
            DiagramObjectCollection<Connector> connectors = new DiagramObjectCollection<Connector>();  
            protected override void OnInitialized()  
            {  
                Node node1 = new Node() { ID = "node1",OffsetX = 100, OffsetY = 100, Tooltip=new DiagramTooltip(){Content="node1", OpensOn = "Auto",} };  
                nodes.Add(node1);  
                Node node2 = new Node() { ID = "node2", OffsetX = 240, OffsetY = 100, Tooltip=new DiagramTooltip(){Content="node2", OpensOn = "Custom",} };  
                nodes.Add(node2);  
                Connector connector1=new Connector{ ID="Connector1" , Tooltip=new DiagramTooltip(){Content="connector1"} };
                connectors.Add(connector1);
            }  
            public async void ShowTooltip()
            {
               await diagram.ShowTooltipAsync(diagram.nodes[1] as NodeBase);
            }
            }

remarks.para: The tooltip will only be shown if the target object has a valid configuration.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.DiagramMenuClickEventArgs
member.summary: Provides information about the context menu item click event.

remarks.para: This event argument class contains details about the clicked menu item and provides access to the menu item's properties when a context menu item is selected in the diagram component.

example.code:
<SfDiagramComponent @ref="diagram" Height="600px" Width="90%">
            <ContextMenuSettings @bind-Show="@show"
                                 @bind-ShowCustomMenuOnly="customMenuOnly" 
                                 @bind-Items="@Items" 
                                 ContextMenuOpening="@BeforeOpen" 
                                 ContextMenuItemClick="@ItemClicked"> 
            </ContextMenuSettings>
            </SfDiagramComponent>
             @code {
            SfDiagramComponent diagram;
            ContextMenuSettings ContextMenuSettings;
            List<ContextMenuItem> Items;
            bool customMenuOnly = false;
            bool show = true;
            
            protected override void OnInitialized()
            {
                nodes = new DiagramObjectCollection<Node>();
                connectors = new DiagramObjectCollection<Connector>();
            
                Items = new List<ContextMenuItem>()
                {
                        new ContextMenuItem()
                        {
                            Text = "Save As...",
                            Id = "save",
                            //IconCss = "glyphicon glyphicon-pencil",
                        },
                        new ContextMenuItem()
                        {
                            Text = "Group",
                            Id = "load",
                            //IconCss = "e-save"
                        }
                };
            }
            private void BeforeOpen(DiagramBeforeMenuOpenEventArgs args)
            {
                foreach (ContextMenuItem Item in args.Items)
                {
                    if (Item.Text == "Groups")
                    {
                        args.HiddenItems.Add(Item.Id);
                    }
                }
            }
            private void ItemClicked(DiagramMenuEventArgs args)
            {
                if (args.Item.Text == "Group")
                {
                    diagram.SelectAll();
                    diagram.Group();
                }
            }

members.member:
Invokes the overview events for handling mouse and touch interactions within the .
An containing the event data as JSON that will be deserialized into .
///
This method serves as the JavaScript-invokable entry point for processing mouse and touch events from the client-side overview component.
The method supports six event types: mousedown, touchstart (handled by ), mouseup, touchend, mouseleave (handled by ), and mousemove, touchmove (handled by ).

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.Overview.SfDiagramOverviewComponent.GetHandle(Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.Overview.OverviewMouseEventArgs)
member.summary: Handles mouse down events on the to initiate various user interactions such as drawing, panning, and scaling operations.
member.param: An containing the mouse event data including target element information, position coordinates, and CSS class details. Must not be .

remarks.para: This internal method determines the appropriate action based on the target element that was clicked. It supports three primary interaction modes: drawing on the canvas, panning the overview rectangle, and scaling through resize handles.

For scaling operations, the method identifies the resize direction based on the handle position (Left, Right, Top, Bottom, TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomRight) to enable appropriate resize behavior during mouse move events.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.Overview.SfDiagramOverviewComponent.MouseUp(Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.Overview.OverviewMouseEventArgs)
member.summary: Handles the mouse up event for the and processes various user interactions including panning, resizing, and tap focus operations.
member.param: An containing the mouse event data including position coordinates and target element information.

remarks.para: This method processes the completion of mouse interactions within the overview component. It handles different action types including pan operations and resize operations through helper elements.
When is enabled, single tap events on the overview canvas will reposition the viewport rectangle to center on the clicked location.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.Overview.SfDiagramOverviewComponent.MouseMove(Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.Overview.OverviewMouseEventArgs)
member.summary: Handles mouse movement events within the and processes interactive actions based on current constraints and action state.
member.param: An containing the mouse event data including position coordinates and event details. Must not be .

remarks.para: This internal method processes mouse movement by updating the cursor appearance and tracking the current mouse position. It handles three primary interaction modes based on the active action name and component constraints.
The method supports draw focus operations when is enabled, zoom operations with , and pan operations with .

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SymbolPalette.SfSymbolPaletteComponent
member.summary: Represents how to display a collection of palettes. The palette shows a set of nodes and connectors. It allows you to drag and drop the nodes and connectors into the diagram.
member.remarks: This component provides a visual interface for organizing and accessing diagram symbols, enabling users to easily add elements to their diagrams through drag-and-drop functionality.

example.code:
<SfSymbolPaletteComponent Height="600px" Palettes="@Palettes" [REDACTED]"@SymbolPreview" SymbolHeight="@symbolSizeHeight" GetSymbolInfo="GetSymbolInfo" SymbolWidth="@symbolSizeWidth" SymbolMargin="@SymbolMargin">
            </SfSymbolPaletteComponent >
            @code
            {
                DiagramSize SymbolPreview;
                SymbolMargin SymbolMargin = new SymbolMargin { Left = 10, Right = 10, Top = 10, Bottom = 10 };
                double symbolSizeWidth;
                double symbolSizeHeight;
                DiagramObjectCollection<Palette> Palettes = new DiagramObjectCollection<Palette>();
                DiagramObjectCollection<NodeBase> TNodes = new DiagramObjectCollection<NodeBase>();
                private SymbolInfo GetSymbolInfo(IDiagramObject symbol)
                {
                    SymbolInfo SymbolInfo = new SymbolInfo();
                    SymbolInfo.Fit = true;
                    return SymbolInfo;
                }
                protected override void OnInitialized()
                {
                    SymbolPreview = new DiagramSize();
                    SymbolPreview.Width = 80;
                    SymbolPreview.Height = 80;
                    symbolSizeWidth = 50;
                    symbolSizeHeight = 50;
                    TNodes = new DiagramObjectCollection<NodeBase>();
                    Node TNode2 = new Node()
                    {
                        ID = "node1",
                        Shape = new FlowShape() { Type = NodeShapes.Flow, Shape = NodeFlowShapes.Decision }  
                    };
                    TNodes.Add(TNode2);
                    Palettes = new DiagramObjectCollection<Palette>()
                    {
                        new Palette(){Symbols =TNodes,Title="Flow Shapes",ID="Flow Shapes" },
                    };
                }
            }

member.summary: Represents how to display a collection of palettes in a diagram application. The palette contains a set of nodes and connectors, allowing users to drag and drop them into the diagram area to create flowcharts or diagrams.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SymbolPalette.SymbolDescription
member.summary: Represents the textual description and display properties of a symbol.
member.remarks: This class provides configuration for how symbol descriptions are displayed within symbol palette components.

example.code:
<SfSymbolPaletteComponent Height="600px"   GetSymbolInfo="GetSymbolInfo" >
            </SfSymbolPaletteComponent >
            @code
            {
                private SymbolInfo GetSymbolInfo(IDiagramObject symbol)
                {
                    SymbolInfo SymbolInfo = new SymbolInfo();
                    SymbolInfo.Fit = true;
                    string text = null;
                    if (symbol is Node)
                    {
                        text = ((symbol as Node).Shape as Shape).Type.ToString() + (symbol as Node).ID;
                    }
                    SymbolInfo.Description = new SymbolDescription() { Text = text };
                    return SymbolInfo;
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SymbolPalette.SymbolDescription.Style

member.value: Default value of font color is black. Default value of fill is transparent. Default value of font size is 12. Default value of font family is Arial. Default value of text decoration is

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.SymbolPalette.SymbolDescription.Margin
member.summary: Gets or sets the Margin to the text rendered in the symbol palette.
member.value: The default value is with all sides set to 0.
member.remarks: Defines the spacing around the text content within the symbol description area.

example.code:
<SfSymbolPaletteComponent Height="600px" Palettes="@Palettes" GetSymbolInfo="GetSymbolInfo">
            </SfSymbolPaletteComponent>
            @code
            {
                DiagramObjectCollection<Palette> Palettes = new DiagramObjectCollection<Palette>();
                DiagramObjectCollection<NodeBase> Nodes = new DiagramObjectCollection<NodeBase>();
                private SymbolInfo GetSymbolInfo(IDiagramObject symbol)
                {
                    SymbolInfo SymbolInfo = new SymbolInfo();
                    SymbolInfo.Fit = true;
                    string text = null;
                    if (symbol is Node)
                    {
                        text = ((symbol as Node).Shape as Shape).Type.ToString() + (symbol as Node).ID;
                    }
                    SymbolInfo.Description = new SymbolDescription() { Text = text, Margin = new DiagramThickness(){ Top = 10 } };
                    return SymbolInfo;
                }
                protected override void OnInitialized()
                {
                    Nodes = new DiagramObjectCollection<NodeBase>();
                    Node node1 = new Node()
                    {
                        ID = "node1",
                        Shape = new FlowShape() { Type = NodeShapes.Flow, Shape = NodeFlowShapes.Decision }  
                    };
                    Nodes.Add(node1);
                    Palettes = new DiagramObjectCollection<Palette>()
                    {
                        new Palette(){Symbols =Nodes,Title="Flow Shapes",ID="Flow Shapes" },
                    };
                }
            }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceDiagramModel

member.remarks: A sequence diagram shows how objects interact with each other in a particular scenario of a use case. This model provides the foundation for rendering sequence diagrams by maintaining the relationships between participants and the chronological order of message exchanges.

                {
                umlModel = new UmlSequenceDiagramModel()
                {
                    Participants = new List<UmlSequenceParticipant>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "User",
                            Content= "User",
                            ShowDestructionMarker= true,
                            IsActor= true,
                            ActivationBoxes= new List<UmlSequenceActivationBox>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceActivationBox() { ID = "act1", StartMessageID= "MSG1", EndMessageID= "MSG3" }
                            }
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "Server",
                            Content= "Server",
                            ShowDestructionMarker= true,
                            IsActor= false,
                            ActivationBoxes= new List<UmlSequenceActivationBox>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceActivationBox() { ID = "act2", StartMessageID= "MSG1", EndMessageID= "MSG3" }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    Messages = new List<UmlSequenceMessage>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceMessage()
                        {
                            ID = "MSG1",
                            Content = "User sends request",
                            FromParticipantID = "User",
                            ToParticipantID = "Server"
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceMessage()
                        {
                            ID = "MSG2",
                            Content = "Processing",
                            FromParticipantID = "Server",
                            ToParticipantID = "Server"
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceMessage()
                        {
                            ID = "MSG3",
                            Content = "Server sends response",
                            FromParticipantID = "Server",
                            ToParticipantID = "User"
                        }
                    },
                    Fragments = new List<UmlSequenceFragment>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceFragment()
                        {
                            ID = "frag1",
                            FragmentType = UmlSequenceFragmentType.Optional,
                            Conditions = new List<UmlSequenceFragmentCondition>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceFragmentCondition()
                                {
                                    Content = "Interactions",

                                }
                            }
                        }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceParticipant
member.summary: Represents a participant in the sequence diagram, such as an actor or object. Participants are the entities that interact with each other through message exchanges in the sequence diagram, displayed as vertical lifelines with headers showing their names or roles.
member.remarks:
In UML sequence diagrams, participants can represent:
Actors - External entities that initiate interactions (users, systems, etc.)
Objects - Internal system components, classes, or services
Boundary objects - Interface elements like UI components
Control objects - Controllers or coordinators
Entity objects - Data or business objects
Each participant is rendered with a header box containing its name/content and a vertical dashed lifeline extending downward. Activation boxes can be added to show when the participant is actively processing or responding to messages.

example.code:
<SfDiagramComponent Height="600px" Model="@umlModel">
            </SfDiagramComponent>
            @code
            {
                UmlSequenceDiagramModel umlModel;
                protected override void OnInitialized()
                {
                umlModel = new UmlSequenceDiagramModel()
                {
                    Participants = new List<UmlSequenceParticipant>()
                    {
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "User",
                            Content= "User",
                            ShowDestructionMarker= true,
                            IsActor= true,
                            ActivationBoxes= new List<UmlSequenceActivationBox>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceActivationBox() { ID = "act1", StartMessageID= "MSG1", EndMessageID= "MSG3" }
                            }
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "Server",
                            Content= "Server",
                            ShowDestructionMarker= true,
                            IsActor= false,
                            ActivationBoxes= new List<UmlSequenceActivationBox>()
                            {
                                new UmlSequenceActivationBox() { ID = "act2", StartMessageID= "MSG1", EndMessageID= "MSG3" }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    };
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceParticipant.ID
member.summary: Gets or sets the unique identifier for the participant. This identifier serves as the primary key for referencing the participant throughout the sequence diagram model.
member.value: A representing the unique ID of the participant. This ID is used to reference the participant in messages (FromParticipantID, ToParticipantID), activation boxes, and fragments. The ID must be unique within the sequence diagram and should follow standard naming conventions. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: The ID is case-sensitive and should be descriptive yet concise. Common naming patterns include PascalCase (e.g., "UserService") or descriptive names (e.g., "DatabaseServer").

example.code:

                        {

                            Content= "User"
                        },
                        new UmlSequenceParticipant()
                        {
                            ID = "Server",
                            Content= "Server"
                        }
                    }
                    };
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceParticipant.Content
member.summary: Gets or sets the name or description of the participant. This is the display text that appears in the participant header box and represents the human-readable name or role of the participant.
member.value: A that represents the display name or label of the participant shown in the sequence diagram. This text is rendered in the participant's header box at the top of the lifeline and should be descriptive and user-friendly. The default value is an empty string.
member.remarks: The Content property is used for visual display purposes, unlike the ID property which is used for internal referencing. The content can include spaces, special characters, and descriptive text that helps users understand the participant's role in the sequence. Common examples include "User", "Web Server", "Database", "Payment Service", or "Authentication Controller".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceParticipant.IsActor
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the participant is an actor (stick figure) in the UML sequence diagram. Actors represent external entities that interact with the system, such as users, external systems, or services.
member.value: A value that determines the visual representation of the participant. When true, the participant is rendered as an actor with a stick figure icon in the header. When false, the participant is rendered as an object with a rectangular header box. The default value is false.
member.remarks:
In UML sequence diagrams, actors typically represent:
Human users interacting with the system
External systems or services
Hardware devices or sensors
Time-based triggers or schedulers
Objects (non-actors) represent internal system components like classes, services, databases, or controllers. The visual distinction helps identify the system boundary and clarifies which entities are external to the system being modeled.

                            ID = "Server",
                            Content= "Server",
                            IsActor= false
                        }
                    }
                    };
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceParticipant.ShowDestructionMarker
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to display a destruction (cross) marker at the end of the participant's lifeline. The destruction marker indicates that the participant object is destroyed or goes out of scope at that point in the sequence execution.
member.value: A value that controls the display of the destruction marker. When true, a cross (X) symbol is rendered at the bottom of the participant's lifeline to indicate object destruction or termination. When false, the lifeline ends normally without any destruction indication. The default value is false.
member.remarks:
In UML sequence diagrams, destruction markers are used to show when:
An object is explicitly destroyed or deleted
A temporary object goes out of scope
A connection or session is terminated
A process or thread ends execution
The destruction marker is typically placed after the last message involving the participant and helps clarify the object's lifecycle within the sequence scenario.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceMessage.FromParticipantID

member.value: A representing the ID of the participant that initiates the message. This value must match the ID property of a defined participant in the diagram's Participants collection. Determine the starting point of the message arrow
Validate message relationships during diagram rendering
Calculate message positioning and lifeline intersections
Support self-messages when FromParticipantID equals ToParticipantID

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceMessage.MessageType
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of UML sequence message (e.g., Synchronous, Asynchronous). The message type determines the visual representation of the arrow and indicates the communication pattern between participants.
member.value: A enumeration value indicating the type of message. Different message types are rendered with distinct arrow styles to convey the nature of the communication. The default value is typically Synchronous.
member.remarks:
Common UML sequence message types include:
Synchronous - Solid arrow with filled arrowhead (caller waits for response)
Asynchronous - Solid arrow with open arrowhead (fire-and-forget)
Return - Dashed arrow (return value or response)
Self - Arrow that loops back to the same participant
Create - Arrow pointing to a participant being instantiated
Destroy - Arrow ending with destruction marker
The message type affects both the visual appearance and the semantic meaning of the interaction in the sequence diagram.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Diagram.UmlSequenceFragmentCondition.Fragments
member.summary: Gets or sets the collection of nested fragments within this condition. Nested fragments allow for hierarchical or alternative flow representations within a condition block.
member.value: A of instances that represent sub-fragments scoped within this condition. These nested fragments help define complex interaction structures like loops, alternatives, and optional within a broader condition. The list cannot be set to null, but can be empty. The default value is an empty list.
member.remarks:
Nested fragments enable complex hierarchical structures in UML sequence diagrams:
Nested loops - A loop fragment within an alternative condition
Conditional alternatives - Alternative fragments within an optional block
Parallel processing - Parallel fragments within a loop or condition
Exception handling - Break fragments nested within try-catch scenarios
Each nested fragment operates within the scope of its parent condition and inherits the parent's execution context.

member.value: An that is triggered when the user types a character in the AutoComplete input.
member.remarks: This event allows customization of the filtering process by setting FilteringEventArgs.PreventDefaultAction to true and passing a modified data source and query to the FilterAsync(IEnumerable<TItem>, Query, FieldSettingsModel) method.

example.code:
<SfAutoComplete @ref="AutoCompleteObj" TItem="string" TValue="string" AllowFiltering="true" DataSource="@MyList">
                <AutoCompleteEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" Filtering="@OnFilteringHandler"/>

            @code {
                SfAutoComplete<string, string> AutoCompleteObj { get; set; }
                protected List<string> MyList = new List<string>() { "Small", "Medium", "Large" };
                public async Task OnFilteringHandler(FilteringEventArgs args) {
                    args.PreventDefaultAction = true;
                    var query = new Query().Where(new WhereFilter() { Field = "Text", Operator = "contains", value = args.Text, IgnoreCase = true });
                    await AutoCompleteObj.FilterAsync(MyList, query);

            }

member.summary: Gets or sets the event callback invoked when a character is typed in the filter textbox.
member.value: An that receives a object when triggered.
member.remarks: This event is triggered when the user types in the filter textbox and is enabled. Developers can prevent the default filtering action using and customize the filtering logic by passing a modified query to the FilterAsync method.

example.code:
<SfDropDownList @ref="DDLObj" TItem="string" TValue="string" AllowFiltering="true" DataSource="@MyList">
                <DropDownListEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" Filtering="@OnFilteringHandler"/>
            </SfDropDownList>
            @code {
                SfDropDownList<string, string> DDLObj { get; set; }
                protected List<string> MyList = new List<string> { "Small", "Medium", "Large" };
                public async Task OnFilteringHandler(FilteringEventArgs args)
                {
                    args.PreventDefaultAction = true;
                    var query = new Query().Where(new WhereFilter { Field = "Text", Operator = "contains", value = args.Text, IgnoreCase = true });
                    await DDLObj.FilterAsync(MyList, query);
                }
            }

member.value: true to enable checkbox selection UI; false to disable it. The default is false.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.ListBoxSelectionSettings.ShowSelectAll

<SfListBox Value="@value" DataSource="@vehicleData" TValue="string[]" TItem="ListItem"> <ListBoxFieldSettings Text="Text" Value="ID"></ListBoxFieldSettings> <ListBoxSelectionSettings ShowCheckbox="true" ShowSelectAll="true"></ListBoxSelectionSettings> </SfListBox>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1
member.summary: Represents a Syncfusion Blazor Mention component, which allows users to type a specified character (e.g., '@' or '#') to trigger a popup suggestion list for mentions/tags and select or insert one or more items into any editable target element.
member.remarks: SfMention<TItem> supports both primitive and complex data binding, templates for suggestion and selected item display, grouping, built-in keyboard and accessibility features, and integration with custom queries and data sources. Typical usage scenarios include chat apps, comment systems, tagging, and rich editors.
member.typeparam: Specifies the type of the underlying data source for mention suggestions.
member.summary: Represents a Syncfusion Blazor Mention component that allows users to input a special character (such as '@' or '#'), triggering a filtered suggestion list for mentions or tags that can be inserted into any editable target element.
member.remarks: The SfMention<TItem> component supports custom display templates, grouping, data binding with complex or primitive types, and advanced keyboard navigation. It is typically used in chat, comments, or tagging experiences where the ability to mention people, products, tags, or other entities is required.
member.summary: Contains user actions, APIs, and internal utilities for operating the Syncfusion Blazor SfMention<TItem> component—including programmatic suggestion popup control, key handling, and disabling items.
member.remarks: This partial class provides all imperative API methods, async invokables, and advanced helpers for manipulating the suggestion popup and integrating with JavaScript interop. Calling these methods lets you show or hide the popup, handle keyboard actions, or dynamically disable items from code-behind.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.FilterType
member.summary:
Gets or sets the filter type that specifies the match criteria while searching for mentions. The possible values for the property are:
StartsWith lists the items if the start of the text in the item matches with the search term or input string.
EndsWith lists the items if the end of the text in the item matches with the search term or input string.
Contains lists the items if the item text contains the search term or input string.
member.value: One of the enumeration that specifies the match criteria while searching. The default value is .

example.code: @code{ protected List SizeData = new List() { "Small", "Medium", "Large" }; }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.AllowSpaces
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to continue search action if user enter space after mention character while searching.
member.value: true, the search action takes place even after a space, if the DataSource data's are matched. The default value is false.
member.remarks: By default, the component will only search for mentions when the mention character is immediately followed by a non-whitespace character (e.g. @john but not @ john). However, you can change this behavior and allow the SfMention component to continue searching for mentions even if the user enters a space after the mention character by setting the AllowSpaces property to true.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.RequireLeadingSpace
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a leading space is required before the mention character to trigger the suggestion popup in the Mention component.
member.value: true if a leading space is required to trigger the suggestion popup; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: - When RequireLeadingSpace is set to true, the suggestion popup will appear only if the mention character is preceded by a space. For example, typing "@John" will not trigger the popup unless a space precedes the "@" character. - When RequireLeadingSpace is set to false, the suggestion popup will trigger immediately after detecting the mention character, regardless of the preceding characters. - For backward compatibility, the property defaults to true, ensuring existing applications behave as expected.

example.code:
<SfMention TValue="string" MentionChar="@" RequireLeadingSpace="false" DataSource="@UserList"> 
            </SfMention> 
            
            @code { 
                private List<string> UserList = new List<string> { "John Doe", "Jane Smith", "Alice Brown" }; 
            }

member.summary: Gets or sets an event callback invoked whenever a character is typed in the MultiSelect Dropdown search box.
member.value: An EventCallback<FilteringEventArgs> fired on filter input. Provides the filtering arguments for query overrides.
member.remarks: Prevent the default filter action and enable your own query by setting the FilteringEventArgs.PreventDefaultAction property. You can then pass a modified data source and query to method for custom filtering.

example.code:
<SfMultiSelect @ref="MultiSelectObj" TItem="string" TValue="string" AllowFiltering="true" DataSource="@MyList">
                <MultiSelectEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" Filtering="@OnFilteringHandler" />
            </SfMultiSelect>
            @code {
                private SfMultiSelect<string, string> MultiSelectObj;
                private List<string> MyList = new List<string>();
                async Task OnFilteringHandler(FilteringEventArgs args) {
                    args.PreventDefaultAction = true;
                    var query = new Query().Where(new WhereFilter() { Field = "Text", Operator = "contains", value = args.Text, IgnoreCase = true });
                    await MultiSelectObj.FilterAsync(MyList, query);
                }
            }

member.summary: The MultiSelect component contains a list of predefined values from which a multiple value can be chosen.

This partial class defines all public methods on the MultiSelect Blazor component for explicit programmatic control and advanced custom scenarios. All public methods are documented with parameter and return information for developer tooling and API browsing.
member.summary: The component enables users to select multiple values from a list of predefined options, supporting filtering, customization, virtualization, and templating for rich dropdown scenarios.
member.remarks: Use this component to provide modern multiple selection input, including grouped, filtered, and virtualized item lists. It supports custom templates, performance optimizations for large datasets, and full accessibility.

remarks.para: TValue: Specifies the value type.
TItem: Specifies the type of SfMultiSelect.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMultiSelect`2.DebounceDelay
member.summary:
Gets or sets the debounce delay in milliseconds for filtering the items in the component. The debounce delay represents the time delay between the last keystroke and the filtering operation. This delay helps reduce the frequency of data filtering while typing. The default value is 300 milliseconds.
The property only takes effect when the property is set to true.
member.value: An integer representing the debounce delay in milliseconds. The default value is 300.
member.example: The following example demonstrates how to set the property to 500 milliseconds.
member.remarks: The property helps optimize performance by delaying the filtering operation until the user has stopped typing for the specified delay duration. To work with the default filtering scenario, the user needs to set the `DebounceDelay` value to zero.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeDownloadEventArgs`1
member.summary: Represents the class for BeforeDownload event arguments.
member.remarks: The Download operation is handled by using form submit and not by using Http request, so it is not possible to pass the HttpClientInstance here. However, you can send custom values from client to server for Download operation by preventing our default download operation using args.Cancel in BeforeDownload event. Then you can trigger the customized download operation using an interop call where you can pass custom values to server side.
member.typeparam: Specifies the TValue of the FileManager.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeDownloadEventArgs`1.Cancel
member.summary: 'true' if the download operation must be cancelled. Otherwise,false.
member.remarks: This allows the users to cancel the download of specific files or folders in required cases.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeDownloadEventArgs`1.DownloadData
member.summary: Gets or sets the data to be sent to the server when downloading files from the FileManager.
member.remarks: The class encapsulates the data required to perform a download operation on the FileManager. This property should be set to an instance of the class that specifies the file(s) to be downloaded, as well as any additional parameters that may be required by the server. When this property is set, the FileManager will send a request to the server to initiate the download. The server should respond with the requested file(s) in the appropriate format (e.g., as a byte array or as a file stream). The FileManager will then download the file(s) and provide them to the user for download.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeDownloadEventArgs`1.HttpClientInstance
member.summary: Gets or sets the HttpClient instance through which http request for the file providers are sent.
member.remarks: The users can pass the required JWT token or authentication token with this instance.

member.summary: Gets or sets the file stream to be downloaded from the server.
member.value: The file stream to download.
member.remarks: The users can pass the file stream to be downloaded from the server.

member.summary: Gets or sets the file name to be downloaded from the server.
member.value: The file name to be downloaded.
member.remarks: The users can pass the file name to be downloaded from the server.

member.summary: Gets or sets a value whether the download perform through form submit method or using HTTP client instance.
member.value: true perform download operation using form submit method; otherwise perform download using HTTP client instance, false. The default value is true.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeImageLoadEventArgs`1
member.summary: Represents the class for BeforeImageLoad event arguments.

member.typeparam: Specifies the TValue of the FileManager.

member.summary: Gets or sets the current rendering image item details as an array of JSON object.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeImageLoadEventArgs`1.ImageUrl
member.summary: Gets or sets the URL of an image, along with any custom attributes that should be sent to the server.
member.remarks: The property is used to specify the URL of an image that should be displayed in the FileManager. You can also include any custom attributes that should be sent to the server along with the image request, such as authentication tokens or session IDs. The server can then use these attributes to customize the image response or perform additional validation before returning the image data.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeImageLoadEventArgs`1.FileStream
member.summary: Gets or sets the image file stream to be loaded.
member.value: The image file stream.
member.remarks: The users can pass the image file stream to be loaded with preview.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeImageLoadEventArgs`1.HttpClientInstance
member.summary: Gets or sets the instance used for sending HTTP requests to file providers.
member.remarks: Authentication tokens, such as JWT, can be configured with this instance to secure requests. This property is optional; if not set, default HTTP client settings will be applied. Note: This property is not applicable for flat data rendering, where file data is determined based on the server data.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeImageLoadEventArgs`1.UseImageAsUrl
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the image source should be represented as an URL or in Base64 format.
member.value: true if the image source is an URL; otherwise, false. The default is true.
member.remarks:
- Set this property to true to render the image source as an URL, suitable for direct referencing from a server. This approach is ideal when the images are publicly accessible or the File Manager can handle image URLs directly.
- Set this property to false to render the image source as a Base64-encoded string. This is particularly useful in scenarios where the File Manager must authenticate requests in order to access the images.

The property specifies the name of the AJAX action that is performed by the FileManager when the user performs an action such as uploading a file, renaming a file, or deleting a file. This property is set automatically by the FileManager when the user interacts with the interface, but can also be set manually in custom code. Returns the following actions name

Image Preview
File Details
Rename
Delete
Duplicate Items
Errors

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.BeforeSendEventArgs.CustomData
member.summary: Gets or sets the custom data to be sent to the server with each AJAX request.
member.remarks: The property is used to specify custom data that should be sent to the server with each AJAX request made by the FileManager. This data can be used by the server-side code to customize the behavior of the FileManager or perform additional processing on the uploaded files. To set the custom data for the FileManager, create a new object and add the desired key-value pairs. Then, assign this object to the property of the FileManager. Note that the keys and values in the dictionary must be serializable, since they will be sent to the server as part of the AJAX request.

member.summary: Defines the search settings for the filemanager component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerSearchSettings.AllowSearchOnTyping
member.summary: Gets or sets a value to enable or disable the search functionality on typing.
member.value: The default value is `true`.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerSearchSettings.FilterType
member.summary: Gets or sets the filter type while searching the content. The available filter types are: `Contains` `StartsWith` `EndsWith`.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerSearchSettings.FilterDelay
member.summary: Gets or sets the delay time (in milliseconds) before starting the search operation based on the filter value in the component. A value of 0 indicates no delay.
member.value: An integer representing the delay time (in milliseconds) before filtering starts. A value of 0 means no delay.
member.remarks: By default, the filter query is sent to the server after 500ms of the last input entered in the search box. Setting a delay value here will introduce a delay before filtering starts.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerSearchSettings.IgnoreCase
member.summary: If ignoreCase is set to false, searches files that match exactly, else searches files that are case insensitive(uppercase and lowercase letters treated the same).

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerSearchSettings.Placeholder
member.summary: Gets or sets the placeholder value to the search input of the File Manager component.
member.value: Accepts a string. The default value is Null.
member.remarks: The search input displays the default placeholder text value as "Search + current selected folder name".
member.example:
In the below code example, the placeholder value sets a "Search More Files.." in the FileManager component.
<SfFileManager TValue="FileManagerDirectoryContent"> <FileManagerSearchSettings Placeholder="Search More Files.."></FileManagerSearchSettings> </SfFileManager>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings
member.summary: Defines the upload settings for the filemanager component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.AllowedExtensions
member.summary: Specifies the extensions of the file types allowed in the file manager component and pass the extensions with comma separators. For example, if you want to upload specific image files, pass allowedExtensions as ".jpg,.png".

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.AutoClose
member.summary: Defines whether to close the upload dialog after uploading all the files.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.AutoUpload
member.summary: By default, the FileManager component initiates automatic upload when the files are added in upload queue. If you want to manipulate the files before uploading to server, disable the autoUpload property. The buttons "upload" and "clear" will be hided from file list when the autoUpload property is true.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.UploadMode
member.summary: Gets or sets the upload mode to perform the upload operation.
member.remarks: Use this property to specify the upload method in the File Manager component. By setting this property to , you can handle the upload operation using the HTTP client instance, which allows you to authorize the upload response.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.ChunkSize
member.summary: Specifies the ChunkSize to split the large file into chunks and upload it to the server in a sequential order.
member.value: If the ChunkSize property has value, the File Manager enables the chunk upload by default. It must be specified in bytes value.
member.remarks: This property is particularly useful for uploading large files to the File Manager, as it allows for more efficient and reliable uploads by dividing the file into smaller pieces. Note that while the property defines the chunk size, an appropriate tokenizer or similar mechanism is required on the server to handle the division and processing of the file data into chunks, ensuring seamless upload and reassembly on the server.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.MaxFileSize
member.summary: Specifies the maximum allowed file size to be uploaded in bytes. The property is used to make sure that you cannot upload too large files.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.MinFileSize
member.summary: Specifies the minimum file size to be uploaded in bytes. The property is used to make sure that you cannot upload empty files and small files.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.DropArea
member.summary: Gets or sets the selectors for target elements to perform file uploads with drag and drop interactions.
member.value: Accepts a string value that denotes the selector where the file has to be dropped. The default value is layout area of the corresponding File Manager.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.DirectoryUpload
member.summary: Gets or sets a boolean value that indicates whether the directory (folder) can be browsed and uploaded in the FileManager component.
member.value: true if the FileManager component allows browsing and uploading of directories (folders); otherwise, false.
member.remarks:
Enabling directory upload allows users to upload directories (folders) by selecting the directory upload option in the toolbar or by dragging and dropping directories into the file manager. When directories are uploaded, all files and subdirectories within them are also uploaded. Note that directory (folder) upload is only supported by the following file system providers:
Physical provider
NodeJS provider
Azure provider
Amazon S3 provider

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.SfFileManager`1
member.summary: This class hold constants of file manager.

The SfFileManager is a graphical user interface component for managing the file system that allows the users to perform most common file operations like accessing, editing, and sorting the files and folders.
member.typeparam: The generic type parameter.
member.summary: The SfFileManager is a graphical user interface component for managing the file system that allows the users to perform most common file operation like accessing, editing, and sorting the files and folders.

The Blazor FileManager component is a graphical user interface component for managing the file system that allows users to perform most common file operations like accessing, editing, and sorting files or folders. This component also provides easy navigation for browsing folders to select a file or folder from the file system. .
member.example:
A Blazor FileManager component with file operations.
<SfFileManager TValue="FileManagerDirectoryContent"> <FileManagerAjaxSettings Url = "https://ej2-aspcore-service.azurewebsites.net/api/FileManager/FileOperations" UploadUrl="https://ej2-aspcore-service.azurewebsites.net/api/FileManager/Upload" DownloadUrl="https://ej2-aspcore-service.azurewebsites.net/api/FileManager/Download" GetImageUrl="https://ej2-aspcore-service.azurewebsites.net/api/FileManager/GetImage"> </FileManagerAjaxSettings> </SfFileManager>

The AllowDragAndDrop property is only applicable for drag and drop within the FileManager. `Note:` - Setting AllowDragAndDrop to false only prevents drag and drop for internal folders and files inside the FileManager component itself. - However, it does not prevent external drag-and-drop upload operations in the Blazor FileManager component. - To prevent external drag-and-drop uploads, set the property in to null.

member.value: true if multi-selection is enabled; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: When multi-selection is enabled, users can select multiple files or folders in the component by holding down the CTRL key and clicking on the files or folders they want to select. Consecutive files or folders can be selected by holding down the SHIFT key and clicking on the first and last file or folder in the range.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.FileManager.SfFileManager`1.EnableVirtualization
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether virtualization is enabled in the FileManager. When enabled, only a subset of files and folders is loaded based on the viewport size, with additional items dynamically loaded as the user scrolls. This improves performance by reducing initial load time and memory usage, especially when handling a large number of files and folders.
member.value: true to enable virtual scrolling; otherwise, false. The default value is false.

item.description: Programmatic selection using the SelectAllAsync method is not supported when virtual scrolling is enabled.
The keyboard shortcut CTRL+A will only select files and directories currently visible in the viewport, rather than all files and directories in the entire directory tree.
Selected file items are not retained while scrolling or switching views, ensuring optimal performance of the component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttAssignmentFields`2.Units
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the unit property in the resource assignment collection in the Gantt Chart.
member.value: The name of the resource units property that specifies the resource units of the resource collection in the of the Gantt chart, and referencing .

remarks.para: Use this property to specify the percentage of time or quantity dedicated to a task for a work or resource.

Examples: - Specify 100% if the resource is to work full-time on the assignment. This is the default for all assignments. - Specify 50% if the resource is spending half the available time on this assignment. - Specify 300% if three full-time equivalent resources are working on this assignment. - Specify 250% if two full-time resources and one half-time resource are working on this assignment.
When you want to specify how much of a work resource's time is dedicated to a specific task, or indicate the quantity of material for an assignment, use this property to define assignment units.

member.summary: Configures the critical path settings for the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttCriticalPathSettings.SlackValue
member.summary: Gets or sets the slack value, in number of days, which is used to determine whether a task is critical in the Gantt chart.
member.value: The number of days between the project's end date and task's end date that must elapse before the task is considered critical. The default value is zero.
member.remarks: Slack is a measure of how many days a task can be delayed without affecting the project's completion. Tasks with zero or negative slack values are critical, while tasks with positive slack values are non-critical. If a task's end date is the same as the project's end date, the slack value is 0, and the task is considered critical. For example, consider a project with an end date of January 15th, 2023. If a task has an end date of January 14th, 2023, and the slack value is zero, then the task is considered non-critical. If the slack value is 1, then the task is considered critical. On the other hand, if the task has an end date of January 16th, 2023, and the slack value is zero, then the task is considered critical. If the slack value is -2, then the task is considered non-critical.

Conversely, this event is invoked for each field with Action set to Remove when calling the ClearFilteringAsync API with the column's field name as a parameter. In this scenario, you can access detailed information in the corresponding event arguments.

member.value: An event callback function that is invoked before the dialog is closed.

example.code:
<SfGantt> 
                <GanttEvents GanttDialogClosing="OnGanttDialogClosing" TValue="TaskData"></GanttEvents> 
            </SfGantt>

                { 
                    // Example: Prevent dialog from closing if task name is empty 
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.Data.TaskName)) 
                    { 
                        args.Cancel = true; // Cancel dialog close if data is invalid 
                    }        
                } 
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttKeySettings.MoveLeftCell
member.summary:
Gets or sets any or all of the following hot keys for the left cell movement.
Shift+Tab Moves to left cell on pressing Shift+Tab key
LeftArrow Moves to left cell on pressing LeftArrow key
Shift+LeftArrow Moves to left cell on pressing Shift+LeftArrow key
The default value are Shift+Tab,LeftArrow,Shift+LeftArrow.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttKeySettings.MoveRightCell
member.summary:
Gets or sets any or all of the following hot keys for the right cell movement.
Tab Moves to right cell on pressing Tab key
RightArrow Moves to right cell on pressing RightArrow key
Shift+RightArrow Moves to right cell on pressing Shift+RightArrow key
The default value are Tab,RightArrow,Shift+RightArrow.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttKeySettings.MoveUpCell
member.summary:
Gets or sets any or all of the following hot keys for the up cell movement.
Shift+Enter Moves to top cell on pressing Shit+Enter key
UpArrow Moves to top cell on pressing UpArrow key
Shift+UpArrow Moves to top cell on pressing Shift+UpArrow key
The default value are Shift+Enter,UpArrow,Shift+UpArrow.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttKeySettings.MoveDownCell
member.summary:
Gets or sets any or all of the following hot for the down cell movement.
Enter Moves to down cell on pressing Enter key
DownArrow Moves to down cell on pressing DownArrow key
Shift+DownArrow Moves to down cell on pressing Shift+DownArrow key
The default value are Enter,DownArrow,Shift+DownArrow.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttKeySettings.IndentRow
member.summary:
Gets or sets any hot keys combination for indenting the row.
Alt+Shift+RightArrow Indent the row on pressing Alt+Shift+RightArrow keys
The default value is Alt+Shift+RightArrow.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttKeySettings.OutdentRow
member.summary:
Gets or sets any hot keys combination for outdenting the row.
Alt+Shift+LeftArrow Indent the row on pressing Alt+Shift+LeftArrow keys

member.value: The default value is false. If set to true, diacritic characters or accents will be ignored while filtering.
member.remarks: If IgnoreAccent is set to true, filtering will ignore diacritic characters or accents, which means that the filter will consider two strings that differ only by diacritic characters or accents to be the same. This property is supported by remote data alone. When the IgnoreAccent property is set to true, the IgnoreAccent key will be sent to the server and the operation should be handled at the user level.

member.summary: Gets or sets the selection mode for the Gantt chart control.
member.value: A value that specifies the selection mode. The default value is .
member.remarks: This property determines how the user can select elements in the Gantt control. When the is set to , the control allows the user to select entire rows of data. When the is set to , the control allows the user to select individual cells. When the is set to , the control allows the user to select both rows and cells.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttSelectionSettings.PersistSelection
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the Gantt selection should be persisted on all operations. If 'persistSelection' set to true, then the Gantt selection is persisted on all operations.
member.value: true if the Gantt selection should be persisted on all operations; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: This property determines whether the Gantt control should keep the user's selection even if the user performs other operations on the control, such as sorting or filtering the data. When is set to true, the selection will be maintained even when the control is updated or refreshed. When is set to false, the selection will be lost when the control is updated or refreshed.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttSelectionSettings.EnableToggle
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user can perform a toggle action on the selection row. If 'enableToggle' set to true, then the user can able to perform toggle for the selected row.
member.value: If true, the user can perform a toggle action on the selected row. If false, the user cannot perform a toggle action on the selected row. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When true, the user can toggle the selected row by clicking on it. The toggle action will change the selected row's state, typically visually highlighting or changing the row's appearance in some way. When false, the user cannot perform the toggle action and the selected row remains in its default state.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttSelectionSettings.Type
member.summary: Gets or sets the selection type for the component. They are `Single`: Allows selection of only a row or a cell. `Multiple`: Allows selection of multiple rows or cells.
member.value: Allows selection of only one row or one cell at a time. This is the default selection type.
member.remarks: When the selection type is set to , the user can select only one row or one cell at a time. When the selection type is set to , the user can select multiple rows or cells at a time. The default selection type is .

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.GanttSelectionSettings.AllowDragSelection
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to enable selection of multiple rows and cells by dragging mouse.
member.value: true if the row and cell selection enabled when dragging mouse. Otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: To perform drag selection in grid part of Blazor Gantt, set as Multiple.

In the below code example, enabled AllowDragSelection property
<SfGantt @ref="Gantt"> <GanttSelectionSettings AllowDragSelection = "true" Type="Syncfusion.Blazor.Grids.SelectionType.Multiple"></GanttSelectionSettings> </SfGantt>

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.DialogType
member.summary: Defines the type of dialog operation in the Gantt Chart.
member.remarks: This enum is used in the property to indicate whether the dialog is being used for adding a new record or editing an existing one.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.DialogType.Add
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog is being used to add a new record.
member.remarks: When this value is set, the dialog is configured for creating a new entry in the Gantt Chart.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.DialogType.Edit
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog is being used to edit an existing record.
member.remarks: When this value is set, the dialog is populated with the data of an existing entry for modification.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.CloseAction
member.summary: Defines the method by which a dialog can be closed in the Gantt Chart.
member.remarks: This enum is used in the property to indicate the specific interaction that resulted in the dialog being closed.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.CloseAction.Icon
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog was closed using the close (X) icon.
member.remarks: Selecting this icon typically signifies that the user intends to dismiss the dialog without saving changes.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.CloseAction.Cancel
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog was closed using the Cancel button.
member.remarks: Pressing the Cancel button generally means the user has decided not to proceed with any actions initiated in the dialog.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.CloseAction.Escape
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog was closed by pressing the Escape key.
member.remarks: This keyboard shortcut is often used for quickly dismissing dialogs, maintaining user workflow efficiency.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.CloseAction.Save
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog was closed using the Save button.
member.remarks: The Save button typically signifies that the user wants to save the changes made within the dialog.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.CloseAction.Enter
member.summary: Indicates that the dialog was closed by pressing the Enter key.
member.remarks: Pressing the Enter key often triggers the default action in dialogs, which may include saving changes.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.TaskbarEditingEventArgs`1.Action
member.summary: Gets the taskbar editing action. The available taskbar editing actions are: - ParentDrag - ChildDrag - RightResizing - LeftResizing - ProgressResizing
member.value: Accepts a string value that represents the taskbar editing action.
member.remarks: The Action property represents the taskbar editing action performed in the GanttChart component. It can have different values depending on the type of taskbar manipulation being performed. The available taskbar editing actions are: - ParentDrag: Indicates that the taskbar is being dragged as a parent task. - ChildDrag: Indicates that the taskbar is being dragged as a child task. - RightResizing: Indicates that the right side of the taskbar is being resized. - LeftResizing: Indicates that the left side of the taskbar is being resized. - ProgressResizing: Indicates that the progress portion of the taskbar is being resized. You can use the Action property to determine the type of taskbar editing action that is being performed and respond accordingly in your code.

member.value: The data object representing the task being edited.
member.remarks: The Data property represents the data of the task currently being edited in the GanttChart component. It provides access to the data object that represents the task and contains various properties such as task name, start date, end date, duration, and other task-related information. You can use the Data property to retrieve or modify the data of the task being edited and perform any necessary operations or validations on it.

member.summary: Determines whether the task’s date values are validated and updated automatically based on predecessor values.
member.value: true if validation of task date values based on predecessors is enabled; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: The EnablePredecessorValidation property controls whether Gantt task dates are validated based on their predecessor tasks. /// When set to true, task date values will be validated based on . When set to false, this validation is disabled. By default, EnablePredecessorValidation is set to true, indicating that validation is enabled.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.TaskbarEditingEventArgs`1.EnablePredecessorOffsetValidation
member.summary: Determines whether to restrict taskbar dragging beyond a predecessor value.
member.value: true if taskbar dragging should be restricted to a date less than the predecessor value; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When EnablePredecessorOffsetValidation is set to true, the gantt chart component will enforce a rule that prevents taskbars from being dragged to a date later than the date of their predecessors. If the taskbar is dragged above the given predecessor offset value, it gets reverted to the minimum predecessor value.

member.summary: Validates the start date and end date of dependent tasks with current edited task data and returns the collection of resultant data.
member.remarks: When data is loaded on demand in gantt chart, only current view port data is available to Gantt Chart. Hence during CRUD operations, Gantt Chart cannot identify the dependent tasks which edited data affects. Using this method, we can identify the dependent tasks data in server end and update it.
member.param: Instance of Gantt chart.
Input data source against which dependent tasks needs to be validated.
Edited task data.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.SfGantt`1.AddDialogFields
member.summary: Gets or sets an instance of collection which provides information on tab sections within the dialog for adding new records and the column fields of the grid within each tab section.
member.value: A List instance of .
member.remarks: The tabs that contain the editors for columns include: General:A tab for entering values for the columns of a new gantt record. Dependency: A tab for editing dependencies. Resources: A tab for editing resources. Notes: A tab for editing notes.

example.code:
<SfGantt DataSource="@TaskCollection" AddDialogFields=@addDialogFields Toolbar="@(new List<string>(){ "Add"})">
             <GanttTaskFields Id="TaskId" Name="TaskName" StartDate="StartDate" EndDate="EndDate" Duration="Duration" Progress="Progress"  Dependency="Predecessor" ParentID="ParentId">
             </GanttTaskFields>
             <GanttEditSettings AllowAdding="true"></GanttEditSettings>
             </SfGantt>
             @code{
             private List<TaskData> TaskCollection { get; set; }
             private List<GanttAddDialogField> addDialogFields { get; set; } = new List<GanttAddDialogField>()
             {
               new GanttAddDialogField(){ Fields = new string[]{"TaskId","TaskName","EndDate","Duration"}, HeaderText = "General" , Type = GanttDialogFieldType.General},
               new GanttAddDialogField(){ Fields = new string[]{"Dependency"}, HeaderText="Predecessor" ,Type = GanttDialogFieldType.Dependency }
             };
             }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Gantt.SfGantt`1.ColumnMenuItems
member.summary: Gets or Sets bulit-in menu items of Gantt columns.
member.value:
Column menu items, for example ColumnMenuItems = "@(new string[] { "AutoFillColumns","AutoFitThisColumn"})". The available built-in Column menu items are,
AutoFitAllColumns
Auto fit all columns
AutoFitThisColumn
Auto fit the current column
SortAscending
Sort the current column in ascending order
SortDescending
Sort the current column in descending order
ColumnChooser
To show/hide the TreeGrid columns
Filter
Filter options will show based on filterSettings property
member.remarks: Displays the column menu items when clicking the menu icon on column headers. ShowColumnMenu should be enabled.

example.code:
<SfGantt DataSource = "@TaskCollection" ShowColumnMenu="true" AllowSorting="true" ColumnMenuItems="columnMenuItems">
             <GanttTaskFields Id = "TaskId" Name="TaskName" StartDate="StartDate" EndDate="EndDate"
                Duration="Duration" Progress="Progress" ParentID="ParentId">
             </GanttTaskFields>
             </SfGantt>
             @code{
             private List<TaskData> TaskCollection { get; set; }
